# openqalyregimen

<!-- badges: start -->
[![CircleCI build status](https://circleci.com/gh/PolicyAnalysisInc/openqalyregimen.svg?style=svg)](https://app.circleci.com/pipelines/github/PolicyAnalysisInc/openqalyregimen)
[![codecov](https://codecov.io/gh/PolicyAnalysisInc/openqalyregimen/graph/badge.svg?token=yFUlHZSVe4)](https://app.codecov.io/gh/PolicyAnalysisInc/openqalyregimen)<!-- badges: end -->

## Overview

The openqalyregimen package provides a declarative interface for defining treatment regimens and calculating medication costs. It handles a wide range of cases including:

- Dosing per patient, per m2 of BSA, or per kg of weight, with optional
  averaging over a patient distribution of BSA or weight
- One costing model for every product (tablets, vials and other units): the cheapest
  units covering the dose, exact whole-unit doses, dose rounding against the
  prescribed dose, or a no-wastage scenario
- Drug cost recorded per administration or per dispensing, with separate
  administration and dispensing fees
- Handling of loading doses, dose escalation, and sequencing
- Correctly attributes all costs to the model cycle schedule, even when medication cycles do not align with model cycles
- Extensive debugging output to ensure transparency
- Out of the box compatability with openqaly models, but can also be used independently

## Installation

``` r
# Install the development version from GitHub
remotes::install_github("PolicyAnalysisInc/openqalyregimen")
```

## Basic Example

```{r}
library(openqalyregimen)

reg <- define_regimen(
  name = "Capecitabine",
  route = "oral",
  dose_per_admin = 2000,
  dose_basis = "bsa",
  patient_bsa = 1.8,
  patient_bsa_sd = 0.2,
  med_cycle_length = 21,
  admin_days = 1:14,
  max_med_cycles = 4,
  unit_size = c(150, 500),
  unit_cost = 2.21,
  exact = FALSE,
  charge_timing = "per_dispensing",
  dispensing_cost = 45
)

calculate_med_costs(
  reg,
  model_cycle_length = 21,
  n_cycles = 4
)
```

Because the dose is averaged over a BSA distribution, this example uses
`exact = FALSE`: for each BSA the cheapest tablets covering the dose are
costed. Exact whole-tablet dosing (`exact = TRUE`) needs a fixed dose.

## Learn more

The package vignettes cover:

- Oral regimens
- IV and injection regimens
- Combinations, loading doses, and phase changes
- Use inside an `openqaly` model
